seoTitle: robots.txt Formatter: Tidy Casing, Spacing and Order
metaDescription: Clean up a robots.txt: consistent directive casing, one space after the colon, blank lines between groups and fixed typos. Comments are kept.
intro: Rewrites a robots.txt into a consistent layout without changing its meaning, and keeps your comments.
why:
Files edited by many people end up with User-agent in three casings, spaces before colons and blank lines in odd places. It still works, but it is hard to review and easy to break.

The formatter normalises directive names, puts a single space after the colon, separates groups with one blank line and can fix misspellings such as Disalow. You can also sort consecutive rule lines by path. Comments stay where they are.
howTo: Choose whether to sort rules and fix typos.

faq.q: What does Fix misspelled directives do?
faq.a: It rewrites known typos such as Disalow to Disallow so every crawler understands them.
